meta.title: Reference library — Palsya
meta.description: Guides for your stage and your programme material.

library.pageSub: Everything in the knowledge base, plus your own programme material. Free to read and free to share.
library.tapingBlurb: All three techniques, with the strip placement and the tension for each.
library.exercisesBlurb: Every exercise, why it is there, and the mistake people make with it.
library.routineBlurb: Eye care, eating, sleep, and fitting this into a life that already exists.

consults.pageSub: Thirty minutes with a facial rehabilitation specialist. You choose who.
consults.mostPeopleWrong: Most people are doing one or two things wrong — usually taping tension or effort level. A clinician normally spots it in the first ten minutes.
consults.bookingUnavailable: Online booking isn't available yet. Nothing has been booked for you.
consults.noClinicianBody: When a clinician is assigned to you, their name appears here.

meta.title: Settings — Palsya
meta.description: Your account, reminders, language, subscription and privacy.

account.managedHint: Your name and email come from your sign-in account. Contact support to change them.

programme.askClinicianReview: Ask a clinician to review this
programme.reviewPendingBody: You can carry on with your programme in the meantime; if the review changes anything you will be told what and why.
programme.retakeAssessmentHint: If a lot has changed — new movement, synkinesis appearing, a stretch of illness — retaking it re-places you. Your history is kept.

reminders.remindersHint: One reminder per session, at a time you pick. Nothing follows up on a missed one, and nothing implies you have let anyone down.
reminders.weeklySummary: Weekly email summary of what was measured and logged
reminders.clinicianUpdates: Email me when a clinician adds a note or changes my programme
reminders.languageHint: Changes the interface language straight away.
reminders.mirrorCamera: Mirror the camera preview during scans
reminders.saveFailed: That didn't save. Please try again.

subscription.cancelHint: Cancelling online isn't available yet. Contact support and we'll cancel it for you.

privacy.consentsHint: What you agreed to during sign-up. Changing a consent here isn't available yet — contact support if you want one changed.

consent.clinician_share: Sharing progress with a clinician I choose

privacy.deleteAccountHint: Permanent. Images go within 30 days, everything else within 90, except invoices we are legally required to keep. There is no reactivation.
privacy.deleteAllMyData: Delete my account and all my data
privacy.selfServiceHint: Exporting and deleting your data yourself isn't available yet. Contact support and we'll do it for you.
